# Retro IDE

Retro IDE is a shared Windows and Linux development environment for retrocomputing emulators. The initial Avalonia workbench has docked and floating tools, document tabs including Emulation, and a focus command shared by the menu, command bar, shortcut, and MCP clients. Project browsing, editing, Git, and emulator integration are planned in the [implementation plan](docs/plans/PLAN-RETROIDE-001.md).

The initial target presets are [UAE](profiles/uae.json), [VICE](profiles/vice.json), and [ViceSharp](profiles/vice-sharp.json). Each selects an emulator bundle from the planned **Emulators** manager. The [bundle publishing and adapter design](docs/architecture.md#emulator-bundles-and-buckets) describes the catalog, package lifecycle, and integration for each target.

## Run the workbench

```sh
dotnet build RetroIde.sln -c Release
dotnet run --project src/RetroIde.Workbench -c Release --no-build
```

Start the desktop with `-- --mcp` to issue an observer attachment or `-- --mcp-mutate` to allow the attached client to focus tools. The workbench shows the path to its private attachment file. A stdio client can launch `dotnet` with the built `RetroIde.Mcp.Stdio.dll` and that file path as arguments. A Streamable HTTP client uses the loopback endpoint and bearer token from the same file. Call `workbench_get_context` to capture the public ViewModel context, then supply that context with a tool ID such as `registers` to `workbench_focus_tool`.

Run `dotnet test RetroIde.sln -c Release --no-build` for the managed tests. The UI suite drives the workbench through SharpNinja.Avalonia.RemoteControl on Avalonia Headless and needs no physical keyboard or mouse. RemoteControl is loaded only by the test projects. Run `pwsh -File eng/Verify-Phase01Trace.ps1 -QBrainExport docs/requirements/phase-01-test-criteria.yaml` to verify the compiled requirement trace.

The Windows build also runs `dotnet run --project tests/RetroIde.NativeTests -c Release --no-build -- --remote-control` to focus a real Win32 workbench and verify distinct main and floating windows through Dock’s float and redock operations.

The separate native smoke test checks platform cursor rendering and the interactive tear-away and redock gestures. Run `dotnet run --project tests/RetroIde.NativeTests -c Release --no-build` from an available Windows desktop. The Windows CI job runs this smoke test when `RETRO_IDE_RUN_NATIVE_POINTER_TESTS` is set to `1`. Linux CI runs it on an isolated Xvfb display with the static X11 core cursor.

```powershell

asset-review --asset-root docs/design --title "Retro IDE"
```

# PLAN-RETROIDE-001 — Retro IDE BDPv4 implementation plan

**Status** — Planned on 2026-11-24. Product implementation and acceptance evidence are pending.

**Baseline** — The live Retro IDE QBrain workspace returned 15 functional, 15 technical, and 15 testing requirements linked in 15 sets, with 176 acceptance criteria. All 45 records were pending. The published design is [Retro IDE Architecture](https://github.com/sharpninja/retro-ide/wiki/Architecture), [MCP Tools](https://github.com/sharpninja/retro-ide/wiki/MCP-Tools), and [C4 Model](https://github.com/sharpninja/retro-ide/wiki/C4-Model). Source commit `fecb1622ac493f51e86612ddb30522d8d64b131b`, wiki commit `ad1c2850ce4dc51859295c24504e8cc90adb5ced`, C4 snapshot `design-12-mcp-viewmodel-context`.

## Goal and V²

- **Viable.** A real Windows and Linux workbench can exercise live ViewModel registration and both MCP transports with a local fixture. This proves shared dispatch and context behavior before installing an emulator. Later phases prove the versioned adapter contract against each shipped backend.
- **Valuable.** A developer can inspect and control the same docked IDE from the workbench, a CLI agent, or a desktop agent. Subsequent phases add project navigation, editing, Git, language servers, builds, and debugging for UAE, VICE, and ViceSharp.
- **Release boundary.** Deliver Retro IDE, its emulator bundle manager and MCP tools on Windows and Linux. Backend authorization and emulation behavior belong to the selected adapter host. The UAE worker and A1200 OS have their own workspaces. [Requirement ownership](../requirement-ownership.md) · [Published FR → TR → TEST mapping](https://github.com/sharpninja/retro-ide/wiki/TR-per-FR-Mapping)

## Architecture and build seams

| Planned project | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `RetroIde.Application` | Feature registry, typed command/query contracts, CQRS Unit of Work, application model and ports. Queries read state. Commands validate context and publish outcomes. |
| `RetroIde.Workbench` | Avalonia and Dock.Avalonia, ViewModels and controllers, composition, window/MDI routing, persisted layout, and dispatcher adapter. |
| `RetroIde.Mcp` | Official MCP C# SDK tool discovery, schemas, scope, transport policy, operation tracking, and request/response mapping. Resolve ViewModel contexts through a registration port provided by the workbench. |
| `RetroIde.Mcp.Stdio` | CLI attachment to a selected running IDE instance through its local endpoint. Use a per-launch attachment descriptor. Standard output carries only MCP messages. |
| `RetroIde.Adapters.Abstractions` and provider projects | Versioned .NET bundle/adapter contracts and backend mappings as each provider lands. Keep desktop dependencies outside adapter hosts. |
| `RetroIde.UnitTests` and `RetroIde.IntegrationTests` | Criterion-linked tests and negative controls, then real dispatcher, SDK client, native window, and provider tests through production entry points. |

Use .NET 10 as the proposed baseline. Pin SDK and package versions against the Windows and Linux build in Phase 01. Apply `Meziantou.Analyzer` centrally to every .NET project, including tests and providers. Keep any Nuke project outside the product solution. Compile public XML documentation and link public contracts and tests to QBrain criteria in CI. Use the existing desktop designs as the interaction reference. [Wireframes and storyboards](../design/_manifest.md)

## First executable increment

Launch the workbench, float and redock a tool pane, and focus it from the IDE. Then inspect the live `WorkbenchViewModel` context and use it to invoke the same focus operation from stdio and Streamable HTTP. Compare visible focus, modeled result, and revision from the same starting state. Repeat with a stale revision and a closed or replaced registration. Expect a structured rejection and unchanged state.

| Boundary | Proposed first contract |
| --- | --- |
| Live view | `WorkbenchViewModel : ObservableObject, IView` implements the IDE's extension of `GPS.SimpleMVC.Views.ISimpleView`. It registers directly with the main `SimpleControllerBase` controller. A unique `ViewKey` identifies that registration. |
| UI binding | Menu, command bar, and shortcut use one Toolkit `ICommand` per activation scope for `workbench.view.focus`. Its descriptor supplies label slug, icon slug, and default gesture. `CommandRequested` captures the request ID, command ID, source `ViewKey`, context, and cancellation when applicable. The registered owner subscribes once and detaches on unregister. |
| MCP context | Proposed public members include `ViewKey`, `WorkspaceId`, `ActiveToolId`, and `WorkbenchRevision`. Explicit exposure metadata on those members drives schema and read-only snapshot serialization. Capture on `Dispatcher.UIThread` and scope the snapshot to the authenticated caller. The schema allowlist excludes commands, callbacks, services, and credentials. |
| Typed requests | Proposed tools `workbench_get_context` and `workbench_focus_tool`. Focus carries its target `ToolId` as typed operation input and the ViewModel identity and expected revision as context. UI and MCP use the same query or command and Unit of Work handler. |
| Dispatch and response | Resolve the instance, workspace, live view, and capability grants. Check revision at the write boundary so racing requests with the same revision cannot both apply. Return correlated IDs, revision, result, or stable error. The registered controller delivers UI results to the originating live view on Avalonia's dispatcher. MCP returns to its caller. Both routes publish observable model changes on the UI thread. |
| Transport | Official `ModelContextProtocol` stdio attach and `ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore` loopback Streamable HTTP target the same IDE and registry. Verify client grants, loopback binding, token, and applicable Origin. Revocation and instance shutdown invalidate attachment. |

Phase 01 test targets are `WorkbenchDispatchTests`, `ViewModelContextContractTests`, `McpWorkbenchTransportTests`, and `NativeDockingTests`. Prove one dispatch per invocation, hidden-member exclusion, correct routing after focus changes, rejection before mutation on stale or cross-workspace context, invalid HTTP Origin, and no second IDE spawned by stdio. Exercise native top-level tear-away/redock on Windows and Linux and record the Linux window-system backend. Use SharpNinja.Avalonia.RemoteControl in the managed Avalonia Headless suite to locate and invoke the production controls without physical keyboard or mouse input. Keep the signed-in Windows desktop smoke test opt-in. Pair these scenarios with deterministic dispatcher and concurrency fixtures.

| Phase 01 slice and prerequisite | Acceptance proof |
| --- | --- |
| 01A — Build and minimal shell | Package restore, analyzers, validated test/trace entry points, and a real workbench process on both hosts. Prove the dockable shell with `TEST-RETRO-001#verify-ac-behavior-desktop-1`. |
| 01B — Shared dispatch and focus, after 01A | Exercise Toolkit binding, owner subscription, cancellation, and result routing against `TEST-RETRO-007#ac-test-simplemvc-views`, `ac-test-cqrs-unit-of-work`, `ac-test-toolkit-bindings`, and `ac-test-view-result-routing`. Use a genuine docked tool as the focus target. |

Establish the workspace/Origin/stale guard coverage of `ac-test-mcp-scope` and the inventory check from `ac-test-mcp-inventory`. ## Iterations and exit evidence

Phase order is `01 → 02 → 03 → 04 → 05 → 06 → 07 → 08`. Once the workspace and document contracts are stable, Git, LSP, and bundle fixtures can be prepared independently. Every delivered feature adds its typed registration, MCP schema and scope checks, and acceptance tests in the same slice.

### 01 — Avalonia workbench and public-context MCP

- Scaffold the projects and managed build, then implement the first increment. Add the IDE layout with shared menu/command bar, major document and Emulation tabs, docked and floating panes, and save/restore. Keep a live registration independent of focus and placement. Restore layout without changing emulator state. Prove the native window workflow with STB01.
- Deliver command descriptors, eligibility, a bundled English catalog, typed MVC events, and a scoped system wait cursor. Track overlapping interaction blocks per operation. Available input and paint stay responsive. Clear cursor overrides after success, cancellation, and failure.
- Add the registry-coverage gate, public context projection, and both transports. Verify schema parity, one handler per request, live context, capability checks, rejection without effects, and visibility of model changes. Target-scoped panes, production reattach, and full tool inventory close in later phases.

### 02 — Project Explorer, tabbed editor, and localization

- Add mixed project/folder roots with stable identities, lazy tree loading, persisted state, and coalesced filesystem refresh. Open and reveal files via modeled context and MCP. Prove with `ExplorerWorkspaceTests`.
- Add AvaloniaEdit tabs that register directly with `DocumentController`. Implement edit, save, close, find/replace, syntax mode, per-tab undo and dirty state, and source navigation. Save captures buffer contents and revision. `DocumentRevisionTests` exercise switching tabs during save, a later edit, a failed save, and a closed view. The breakpoint integration closes in Phase 06.
- Implement typed per-slug text/image resolution, locale-parent-English fallback, persisted language switching, plural/select formatting, RTL, and shortcut validation. `LocalizationWorkflowTests` cover partial and pseudo-localized catalogs, invalid packs, and live docked/floating windows.

### 03 — Git, terminal, and language servers

- Use native Git for repository/worktree discovery, diffs/hunks, index and commit, history, refs/remotes, conflict and operation recovery, stashes, patches, worktrees, submodules, LFS, and an integrated terminal. Preserve native prompts, hooks, signing, locks, and dirty buffers. Run `GitWorktreeIntegrationTests` with local bare remotes, unusual paths, stale hunks, conflicts, external changes, and cancellation. [Git integration](../git-integration.md)
- Configure LSP servers by root and language with framed JSON-RPC, negotiated 3.18/3.17 capabilities and encoding, versioned unsaved buffers, and cancellation/restart. Implement advertised completion, navigation, symbols, diagnostics, and code changes. Validate workspace edits through the same document handlers. Run `LanguageServerIntegrationTests` with a deterministic fixture, clangd and rust-analyzer, Unicode, stale responses, and process restart. Exercise scoped MCP access for both Git and LSP. [Language server contract](../language-servers.md)

### 04 — Emulator manager and adapter conformance

- Implement Git/Scoop-style bucket discovery, manifests, platform selection, hash-checked installs, version pins, receipts, cached/offline use, and transactional recovery. Verify malformed and interrupted installs, side-by-side versions, active-session pins, and incompatible host/contract rejection in `EmulatorBundleIntegrationTests`.
- Implement published adapter and session contracts, typed capability ports, and event/stream semantics. Run `AdapterConformanceTests` against a deterministic adapter for launch/attach, revisions and actor scope, operation outcomes, event gaps, backpressure, disconnect, and compatibility with unknown optional extensions. Bind Emulators UI and MCP tools to the same resolver. [Adapter contract](../emulator-adapter-contract.md)

### 05 — Build, target launch, and real-backend lifecycle

- Implement Build Project and Start Debugging with captured build configuration, progress, diagnostics, and target resolution. Build alone leaves the emulator stopped. Start Debugging launches the captured debug-capable profile only after build success. Verify failed, cancelled, and stale operations in `BuildLaunchWorkflowTests`.
- Integrate UAE Developer's control host first, then VICE `x64sc`/binary monitor and ViceSharp gRPC. Use pinned bundles or configured endpoints. Exercise launch/attach, real session reattach, backend isolation, capability negotiation and permissions through the same conformance suite. Use STB02, STB03, STB14 and STB16. An absent capability returns a structured unavailable result. A required feature without a working provider remains open.

### 06 — Debugger, guest console, and symbols

- Add machine-neutral debugger tools and typed views for supported registers, memory, disassembly, trace, breakpoints, watchpoints and stepping. Route gutter actions and source locations through DocumentController. Retain raw debugger use when symbols are missing.
- Add scoped guest, process, worker, and serial consoles. Negotiate optional 68040/AGA and guest runtime extensions at the adapter boundary. `DebugNavigationIntegrationTests` exercise live supported ports, scope and revision failures, unavailable capabilities, and symbol fallback. Verify STB05, STB06, STB11 and STB12, including editor breakpoint navigation and related MCP tools.

### 07 — Emulation player, media, snapshots, and tests

- Deliver frame/capture presentation, bounded audio queues and host volume, input capture and release, and recording replay in the Emulation tab. Include the progress bar and draggable time marker. Seek only eligible recordings and keep paint responsive under feed backpressure.
- Deliver media mount and safe ejection, snapshot capture/compare/restore, deterministic tests, and diagnostic artifacts. Add bounded reads and image capture plus operation status, progress, result and cancel. Use MCP Tasks when negotiated and preserve the ordinary operation-handle path. Run `EmulationPlayerIntegrationTests` and `MediaSnapshotTestWorkflowTests` using STB04, STB07, STB09, STB10 and STB15. Verify both client modes, interruption, stale requests, scope, and backend authority.

### 08 — Agent workbench, full parity, and release evidence

- Add configured CLI agent and external desktop attach workflows, agent activity, grants/revoke, and reconnect. Verify observer-write denial, capability notifications, cleanup, and live backend independence through STB08 and both STB13 paths.
- Run `McpFeatureCoverageTests` and `ReleaseWorkbenchAcceptanceTests` across representative calls from every published feature group over both transports, all registration mappings, context schema parity, applicable Tasks negotiation, and revoked/cross-scope requests. Package and install the desktop and CLI attach entry point on Windows and Linux. Verify layout and bundle recovery through upgrade and run a human walkthrough on each host.

param(
    [ValidateSet('Release', 'Debug')][string]$Configuration = 'Release',
    [string]$QBrainExport
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot
$productProjects = @(
    'src/RetroIde.Application'
    'src/RetroIde.Mcp'
    'src/RetroIde.Mcp.Stdio'
    'src/RetroIde.Workbench'
)
$nativeEntryPoints = @(
    'M:RetroIde.NativeTests.NativeDockingTests.RunAsync'
    'M:RetroIde.NativeTests.ProductionAttachmentTests.RunAsync'
    'M:RetroIde.NativeTests.RemoteControlDockingTests.RunAsync'
)
$loaded = @{}
function Get-ProjectXml([string]$ProjectPath) {
    if (!$loaded.ContainsKey($ProjectPath)) {
        $name = Split-Path $ProjectPath -Leaf
        $path = Join-Path $root "$ProjectPath/bin/$Configuration/net10.0/$name.xml"
        [xml]$loaded[$ProjectPath] = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw
    }
    return $loaded[$ProjectPath]
}

function Get-CompiledTraceSymbols([string]$ProjectPath, [switch]$ManagedTests) {
    $name = Split-Path $ProjectPath -Leaf
    $path = Join-Path $root "$ProjectPath/bin/$Configuration/net10.0/$name.dll"
    $stream = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($path)
    $pe = [System.Reflection.PortableExecutable.PEReader]::new($stream)
    try {
        # Read metadata without loading application dependencies into PowerShell.
        $metadata = [System.Reflection.Metadata.PEReaderExtensions]::GetMetadataReader($pe)
        foreach ($typeHandle in $metadata.TypeDefinitions) {
            $type = $metadata.GetTypeDefinition($typeHandle)
            $visibility = $type.Attributes -band [System.Reflection.TypeAttributes]::VisibilityMask
            if ($visibility -ne [System.Reflection.TypeAttributes]::Public) { continue }
            $typeName = "$($metadata.GetString($type.Namespace)).$($metadata.GetString($type.Name))"
            if (!$ManagedTests) {
                "T:$typeName"
                continue
            }

            foreach ($methodHandle in $type.GetMethods()) {
                $method = $metadata.GetMethodDefinition($methodHandle)
                foreach ($attributeHandle in $method.GetCustomAttributes()) {
                    $constructor = $metadata.GetCustomAttribute($attributeHandle).Constructor
                    if ($constructor.Kind -ne [System.Reflection.Metadata.HandleKind]::MemberReference) { continue }
                    $declaring = $metadata.GetMemberReference([System.Reflection.Metadata.MemberReferenceHandle]$constructor).Parent
                    if ($declaring.Kind -ne [System.Reflection.Metadata.HandleKind]::TypeReference) { continue }
                    $attribute = $metadata.GetTypeReference([System.Reflection.Metadata.TypeReferenceHandle]$declaring)
                    $attributeName = "$($metadata.GetString($attribute.Namespace)).$($metadata.GetString($attribute.Name))"
                    if ($attributeName -cin @('Xunit.FactAttribute', 'Xunit.TheoryAttribute',
                        'Avalonia.Headless.XUnit.AvaloniaFactAttribute', 'Avalonia.Headless.XUnit.AvaloniaTheoryAttribute')) {
                        "M:$typeName.$($metadata.GetString($method.Name))"
                        break
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    finally {
        $pe.Dispose()
        $stream.Dispose()
    }
}

$criterionPattern = 'TEST-RETRO-\d+#[a-z0-9-]+'
$evidence = foreach ($suite in 'Integration', 'Native', 'Unit') {
    $projectPath = "tests/RetroIde.${suite}Tests"
    $xml = Get-ProjectXml $projectPath
    $entryPoints = if ($suite -eq 'Native') { $nativeEntryPoints } else { @(Get-CompiledTraceSymbols $projectPath -ManagedTests) }
    foreach ($member in $xml.SelectNodes('doc/members/member[starts-with(@name, "M:")]')) {
        $criteria = [regex]::Matches($member.InnerText, $criterionPattern).Value | Sort-Object -Unique
        if (!$criteria) { continue }
        $method = $member.GetAttribute('name') -replace '\(.*$', ''
        if ($method -cnotin $entryPoints) { throw "$method has trace annotations but is not a runnable test entry point." }
        $criteria
    }
}
if (!$evidence) { throw 'No Phase 01 test annotations were found in compiled XML documentation.' }

$contractCriteria = [System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
$contractCount = 0
foreach ($projectPath in $productProjects) {
    $xml = Get-ProjectXml $projectPath
    foreach ($contract in Get-CompiledTraceSymbols $projectPath) {
        $member = $xml.SelectSingleNode("doc/members/member[@name='$contract']")
        if ($null -eq $member) { throw "Missing compiled XML documentation for $contract." }
        $matchesFound = [regex]::Matches($member.InnerText, $criterionPattern)
        if ($matchesFound.Count -eq 0) { throw "No criterion on public contract $contract." }
        foreach ($match in $matchesFound) { [void]$contractCriteria.Add($match.Value) }
        $contractCount++
    }
}
$export = $null
if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('QBrainExport')) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($QBrainExport)) { throw 'Supply a path to the QBrain export.' }
    $export = Get-Content -LiteralPath $QBrainExport -Raw
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($export)) { throw 'The supplied QBrain export is empty.' }
}
$projection = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'docs/requirements/phase-01-test-criteria.yaml') -Raw
$scopedCriteria = foreach ($requirement in [regex]::Matches($projection, '(?ms)^    - id: (TEST-RETRO-\d+)\r?\n(.*?)(?=^    - id:|^  \w+:|\z)')) {
    foreach ($criterion in [regex]::Matches($requirement.Groups[2].Value, '(?m)^      - id: ([a-z0-9-]+)\r?$')) {
        "$($requirement.Groups[1].Value)#$($criterion.Groups[1].Value)"
    }
}
if (!$scopedCriteria) { throw 'The Phase 01 QBrain projection contains no test criteria.' }
$uniqueCriteria = @($evidence | Sort-Object -Unique)
foreach ($criterion in $scopedCriteria) {
    if ($criterion -cnotin $uniqueCriteria) { throw "$criterion has no compiled Phase 01 test link." }
}
foreach ($criterion in $uniqueCriteria) {
    if ($criterion -cnotin $scopedCriteria) { throw "$criterion is outside the Phase 01 QBrain projection." }
    [void]$contractCriteria.Remove($criterion)
    if ($export) {
        $requirementId, $criterionId = $criterion -split '#'
        $records = [regex]::Match($export, "(?ms)^    - id: $requirementId\r?\n.*?(?=^    - id:|^  \w+:|\z)")
        if (!$records.Success -or $records.Value -cnotmatch "(?m)^      - id: $criterionId\r?$") {
            throw "$criterion is missing from the supplied QBrain export."
        }
    }
}
if ($contractCriteria.Count -ne 0) { throw "Public contracts without a mapped test: $($contractCriteria -join ', ')." }

Write-Output "Verified $($evidence.Count) Phase 01 test links and $contractCount documented public contracts."
if ($null -ne $export) {
    $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $QBrainExport -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    Write-Output "Verified $($uniqueCriteria.Count) distinct criteria in the supplied QBrain export (SHA256 $hash)."
}
else {
    Write-Output 'Compiled documentation and trace links verified without a QBrain export.'
}

using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Text.Json.Schema;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace RetroIde.Application;

/// <summary>Opts a read-only ViewModel property into the MCP context contract.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-viewmodel-context</remarks>
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property)]
public sealed class McpContextAttribute : Attribute;

/// <summary>Identifies a live workbench registration and its captured state.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-viewmodel-context</remarks>
public sealed record WorkbenchAddress(Guid ViewKey, Guid WorkspaceId, string? ActiveToolId, long WorkbenchRevision);

/// <summary>Defines the shared context and operation JSON conventions.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-viewmodel-context</remarks>
public static class WireJson
{
    /// <summary>Serializes canonical camel-case names and rejects extra input members.</summary>
    public static JsonSerializerOptions Options { get; } = Create();

    private static JsonSerializerOptions Create()
    {
        var options = new JsonSerializerOptions(JsonSerializerDefaults.Web)
        {
            PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = false,
            UnmappedMemberHandling = JsonUnmappedMemberHandling.Disallow,
            NumberHandling = JsonNumberHandling.Strict,
            RespectRequiredConstructorParameters = true,
            RespectNullableAnnotations = true,
            DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull,
        };
        options.MakeReadOnly(populateMissingResolver: true);
        return options;
    }
}

/// <summary>Builds discovery and snapshots from the same explicit ViewModel property list.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-viewmodel-context</remarks>
public sealed class ViewContextContract
{
    private readonly (string Name, PropertyInfo Property)[] _members;
    private readonly string[] _memberNames;

    /// <summary>Loads and validates the workbench ViewModel's public context metadata.</summary>
    public ViewContextContract(Type viewModelType)
    {
        var nullability = new NullabilityInfoContext();
        _members = viewModelType.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)
            .Where(p => p.IsDefined(typeof(McpContextAttribute), inherit: true))
            .Select(p => (Name: JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase.ConvertName(p.Name), Property: p))
            .OrderBy(member => member.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .ToArray();
        _memberNames = _members.Select(member => member.Name).ToArray();

        var properties = new JsonObject();
        var required = new JsonArray();
        foreach (var (name, property) in _members)
        {
            if (property.GetMethod is not { IsPublic: true } || property.SetMethod is { IsPublic: true } || property.GetIndexParameters().Length != 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Context property {property.Name} must be publicly readable and externally read-only.");

            var nullable = nullability.Create(property).ReadState == NullabilityState.Nullable;
            var schema = WireJson.Options.GetJsonSchemaAsNode(property.PropertyType,
                new JsonSchemaExporterOptions { TreatNullObliviousAsNonNullable = !nullable });
            if (name is "viewKey" or "workspaceId")
                schema["not"] = new JsonObject { ["const"] = Guid.Empty.ToString() };
            if (name == "workbenchRevision")
                schema["minimum"] = 0;
            properties[name] = schema;
            required.Add(name);
        }

        var addressFields = typeof(WorkbenchAddress).GetProperties().ToDictionary(p => JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase.ConvertName(p.Name), StringComparer.Ordinal);
        if (_members.Length != addressFields.Count ||
            _members.Any(member => !addressFields.TryGetValue(member.Name, out var field) || field.PropertyType != member.Property.PropertyType ||
                nullability.Create(field).ReadState != nullability.Create(member.Property).ReadState))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The typed workbench address must match the exposed ViewModel properties.");

        Schema = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new JsonObject
        {
            ["type"] = "object",
            ["properties"] = properties,
            ["required"] = required,
            ["additionalProperties"] = false,
        });
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the closed JSON Schema for the exposed properties.</summary>
    public JsonElement Schema { get; }

    /// <summary>Captures a detached snapshot. Live callers must run on the ViewModel's dispatcher.</summary>
    public JsonElement Capture(object view)
    {
        var snapshot = new JsonObject();
        foreach (var (name, property) in _members)
            snapshot[name] = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(property.GetValue(view), property.PropertyType, WireJson.Options);

        return JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(snapshot);
    }

    /// <summary>Parses a captured context, rejecting missing, repeated, or undeclared keys.</summary>
    public bool TryRead(JsonElement snapshot, out WorkbenchAddress? address)
    {
        address = null;
        if (snapshot.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object ||
            !snapshot.EnumerateObject().Select(p => p.Name).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal)
                .SequenceEqual(_memberNames, StringComparer.Ordinal))
            return false;

        try
        {
            var candidate = snapshot.Deserialize<WorkbenchAddress>(WireJson.Options);
            if (candidate is not { ViewKey: var viewKey, WorkspaceId: var workspace, WorkbenchRevision: >= 0 }
                || viewKey == Guid.Empty || workspace == Guid.Empty)
                return false;

            address = candidate;
            return true;
        }
        catch (JsonException) { return false; }
    }
}

using System.Collections.Immutable;

namespace RetroIde.Application;

/// <summary>Scope and revocable capabilities for one authenticated attachment or workbench view.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-scope</remarks>
public sealed class ActorGrant(string actor, Guid workspaceId, Guid viewKey, bool canMutate)
{
    private readonly Lock _gate = new();
    private bool _revoked;

    /// <summary>Identifies the actor without exposing credentials.</summary>
    public string Actor { get; } = actor;

    /// <summary>Identifies the granted workspace.</summary>
    public Guid WorkspaceId { get; } = workspaceId;

    /// <summary>Identifies the selected live registration.</summary>
    public Guid ViewKey { get; } = viewKey;

    /// <summary>Indicates whether the grant remains usable.</summary>
    public bool IsActive
    {
        get { lock (_gate) return !_revoked; }
    }

    /// <summary>Invalidates the grant, including requests already waiting for the UI dispatcher.</summary>
    public void Revoke()
    {
        lock (_gate)
            _revoked = true;
    }

    internal OperationResult Authorize(Guid operationId, bool mutation, Func<OperationResult> execute)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_revoked)
                return OperationResult.Failure(operationId, "unauthorized", "The attachment has been revoked.");
            if (mutation && !canMutate)
                return OperationResult.Failure(operationId, "forbidden", "This attachment grants read access only.");
            return execute();
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>Common response envelope for UI and MCP workbench operations.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-007#ac-test-cqrs-unit-of-work</remarks>

/// <summary>Identifies a supported IDE operation and its MCP representation.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-inventory</remarks>
public abstract class FeatureRegistration
{
    private protected FeatureRegistration(string id, string toolName, string description, bool mutation)
    {
        Id = id;
        ToolName = toolName;
        Description = description;
        IsMutation = mutation;
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the stable application feature ID.</summary>
    public string Id { get; }

    /// <summary>Gets the published MCP tool name.</summary>
    public string ToolName { get; }

    /// <summary>Gets the discovery description.</summary>
    public string Description { get; }

    public bool IsMutation { get; }

    internal abstract JsonObject InputSchema { get; }

    /// <summary>Adapts wire arguments to the registered typed operation.</summary>
    public abstract Task<OperationResult> InvokeAsync(IWorkbenchDispatcher dispatcher, ViewContextContract contract,
        IDictionary<string, JsonElement>? arguments, ActorGrant actor, Guid operationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}

/// <summary>Pairs one typed input with its scoped handler.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-inventory</remarks>
public sealed class Feature<TInput> : FeatureRegistration where TInput : class
{
    private readonly Func<TInput, IWorkbenchRegistration, (string Code, string Summary)> _handler;

    internal Feature(string id, string toolName, string description, bool mutation,
        Func<TInput, IWorkbenchRegistration, (string Code, string Summary)> handler)
        : base(id, toolName, description, mutation) => _handler = handler;

    internal override JsonObject InputSchema => WireJson.Options.GetJsonSchemaAsNode(typeof(TInput), FeatureRegistry.RequiredRoot).AsObject();

    internal (string Code, string Summary) Execute(TInput input, IWorkbenchRegistration view) => _handler(input, view);

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public override Task<OperationResult> InvokeAsync(IWorkbenchDispatcher dispatcher, ViewContextContract contract,
        IDictionary<string, JsonElement>? arguments, ActorGrant actor, Guid operationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        WorkbenchAddress? address = null;
        var inputJson = new JsonObject();
        if (arguments is not null)
        {
            foreach (var (name, value) in arguments)
            {
                if (IsMutation && string.Equals(name, "context", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    if (!contract.TryRead(value, out address))
                        return Invalid();
                }
                else
                {
                    inputJson[name] = JsonNode.Parse(value.GetRawText());
                }
            }
        }

        if (IsMutation && address is null)
            return Invalid();

        TInput? input;
        try { input = inputJson.Deserialize<TInput>(WireJson.Options); }
        catch (JsonException) { return Invalid(); }

        return input is null ? Invalid() : dispatcher.DispatchAsync(this, input, address, actor, operationId, cancellationToken);

        Task<OperationResult> Invalid() =>
            Task.FromResult(OperationResult.Failure(operationId, "invalid_arguments", "The arguments do not match the tool schema."));
    }
}

    /// <summary>Registers the workbench handlers against the live ViewModel contract.</summary>

    {
        Context = context;
        GetContext = new("workbench.context.read", "workbench_get_context", "Read the selected workbench's live public context.", false,
            static (_, _) => ("ok", "Workbench context read."));
        FocusTool = new("workbench.view.focus", "workbench_focus_tool", "Focus a tool pane using the current workbench context.", true,
            static (input, view) => view.TryFocus(input.ToolId)
                ? ("ok", "Tool focused.")
                : ("tool_unavailable", "The selected tool cannot be focused."));
        Features = ImmutableArray.Create<FeatureRegistration>(GetContext, FocusTool);
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the public workbench context contract shared by its tools.</summary>
    public ViewContextContract Context { get; }

    /// <summary>Gets the context query.</summary>
    public Feature<GetContextInput> GetContext { get; }

    /// <summary>Gets the focus command.</summary>
    public Feature<FocusToolInput> FocusTool { get; }

    /// <summary>Gets all registered operations.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<FeatureRegistration> Features { get; }

    /// <summary>Generates the operation's discoverable argument and result schemas.</summary>
    public FeatureDescription Describe(FeatureRegistration feature)
    {
        var input = feature.InputSchema;
        if (feature.IsMutation)
        {
            input["properties"]!.AsObject().Add("context", JsonNode.Parse(Context.Schema.GetRawText()));
            input["required"]!.AsArray().Add("context");
        }

        var output = WireJson.Options.GetJsonSchemaAsNode(typeof(OperationResult), RequiredRoot).AsObject();
        output["properties"]!.AsObject()["context"] = JsonNode.Parse(Context.Schema.GetRawText());
        return new FeatureDescription(JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(input), JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(output));
    }
}

/// <summary>Serializes authorization, live context validation, handler execution, and result capture on the UI thread.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-007#ac-test-cqrs-unit-of-work; TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-scope</remarks>
public sealed class WorkbenchUnitOfWork(ViewContextContract contract, Func<Guid, IWorkbenchRegistration?> resolve)
{
    /// <summary>Executes one feature in the authorized registration. The caller owns dispatcher affinity.</summary>
    public OperationResult Execute<TInput>(Feature<TInput> feature, TInput input, WorkbenchAddress? captured,
        ActorGrant actor, Guid operationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken) where TInput : class
    {
        return actor.Authorize(operationId, feature.IsMutation, () =>
        {
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                return Reject("cancelled", "The operation was cancelled.");
            if (captured is not null && captured.WorkspaceId != actor.WorkspaceId)
                return Reject("workspace_mismatch", "The context belongs to a different workspace.");

            var view = resolve(captured?.ViewKey ?? actor.ViewKey);
            if (view is null)
                return Reject("view_closed", "The workbench registration is no longer live.");

            var current = view.Address;
            if (current.WorkspaceId != actor.WorkspaceId || current.ViewKey != actor.ViewKey)
                return Reject("view_mismatch", "The registration is outside the attachment scope.");
            if (feature.IsMutation && captured is null)
                return Reject("invalid_arguments", "A captured workbench context is required.");
            if (captured is not null && captured.WorkbenchRevision != current.WorkbenchRevision)
                return Reject("stale_revision", "The workbench changed. Read its current context and retry.");
            if (captured is not null && !string.Equals(captured.ActiveToolId, current.ActiveToolId, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                return Reject("context_mismatch", "The captured tool selection differs from the workbench.");

            var (code, summary) = feature.Execute(input, view);
            return string.Equals(code, "ok", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                ? new OperationResult(operationId, code, summary, contract.Capture(view.ContextSource))
                : Reject(code, summary);
        });

        OperationResult Reject(string code, string summary) => OperationResult.Failure(operationId, code, summary);
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Security.AccessControl;
using System.Security.Principal;
using System.Text.Json;
using RetroIde.Application;

namespace RetroIde.Mcp;

/// <summary>Private per-launch descriptor used to attach to one running workbench.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-scope; TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-same-instance</remarks>
public sealed class AttachmentDescriptor
{
    private readonly string _token;

    internal AttachmentDescriptor(Uri endpoint, string token)
    {
        if (!string.Equals(endpoint.Scheme, Uri.UriSchemeHttp, StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
            !string.Equals(endpoint.Host, IPAddress.Loopback.ToString(), StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
            !string.Equals(endpoint.AbsolutePath, "/mcp", StringComparison.Ordinal) || endpoint.UserInfo.Length != 0 || endpoint.Query.Length != 0 || endpoint.Fragment.Length != 0 ||
            endpoint.Port is <= 0 || token.Length != 64 || !token.All(char.IsAsciiHexDigit))
            throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid local MCP attachment descriptor.");

        Endpoint = endpoint;
        _token = token;
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the local Streamable HTTP endpoint.</summary>
    public Uri Endpoint { get; }

    internal string Token => _token;

    /// <summary>Reads an attachment descriptor selected by the user or client configuration.</summary>
    public static AttachmentDescriptor Read(string path)
    {
        using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        if (stream.Length > 4096)
            throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid local MCP attachment descriptor.");
        var data = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<DescriptorData>(stream, WireJson.Options)
            ?? throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid local MCP attachment descriptor.");
        return new AttachmentDescriptor(data.Endpoint, data.Token);
    }

    /// <summary>Creates a new owner-only descriptor file.</summary>
    public void Write(string path)
    {
        var fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(path);
        var temporary = Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(fullPath)!, $".attach-{Guid.NewGuid():N}.tmp");
        try
        {
            using (var stream = CreatePrivateFile(temporary))
                JsonSerializer.Serialize(stream, new DescriptorData(Endpoint, _token), WireJson.Options);
            File.Move(temporary, fullPath, overwrite: false);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (File.Exists(temporary))
                File.Delete(temporary);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Creates a client for direct MCP access, with redirects and proxies disabled.</summary>
    public HttpClient CreateHttpClient()
    {
        var client = new HttpClient(new SocketsHttpHandler { UseProxy = false, AllowAutoRedirect = false });
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", _token);
        return client;
    }

    private static FileStream CreatePrivateFile(string path)
    {
        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
        {
            using var user = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent();
            var owner = user.User ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("A Windows user is required for MCP attachment.");
            var security = new FileSecurity();
            security.SetAccessRuleProtection(isProtected: true, preserveInheritance: false);
            security.AddAccessRule(new FileSystemAccessRule(owner, FileSystemRights.FullControl, AccessControlType.Allow));
            return new FileInfo(path).Create(FileMode.CreateNew, FileSystemRights.Write, FileShare.None, 4096, FileOptions.None, security);
        }

        return new FileStream(path, new FileStreamOptions
        {
            Access = FileAccess.Write,
            Mode = FileMode.CreateNew,
            UnixCreateMode = UnixFileMode.UserRead | UnixFileMode.UserWrite,
        });
    }

    private sealed record DescriptorData(Uri Endpoint, string Token);
}

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting.Server;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting.Server.Features;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using ModelContextProtocol.Protocol;
using RetroIde.Application;

namespace RetroIde.Mcp;

/// <summary>Hosts authenticated, local Streamable HTTP on the selected workbench process.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-same-instance; TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-scope</remarks>
public sealed partial class LoopbackMcpHost : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private static readonly object GrantKey = new();
    private readonly WebApplication _app;
    private readonly Func<Uri> _endpoint;
    private readonly WorkbenchAddress _scope;
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, ActorGrant> _grants = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Lock _lifecycle = new();
    private bool _disposed;

    private LoopbackMcpHost(WebApplication app, WorkbenchAddress scope)
    {
        _app = app;
        _scope = scope;
        _endpoint = () => new Uri(new Uri(app.Services.GetRequiredService<IServer>().Features.Get<IServerAddressesFeature>()!.Addresses.Single()), "/mcp");
    }

    /// <summary>Starts the official SDK on an OS-assigned IPv4 loopback port.</summary>
    public static async Task<LoopbackMcpHost> StartAsync(FeatureRegistry registry, IWorkbenchDispatcher dispatcher,
        WorkbenchAddress scope, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var builder = WebApplication.CreateSlimBuilder(new WebApplicationOptions { Args = [] });
        builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
        builder.Logging.SetMinimumLevel(LogLevel.Warning);
        builder.Logging.AddFilter(typeof(LoopbackMcpHost).FullName, LogLevel.Information);
        builder.Logging.AddConsole(options => options.LogToStandardErrorThreshold = LogLevel.Trace);
        builder.WebHost.ConfigureKestrel(options =>
        {
            options.Configure(new ConfigurationBuilder().Build());
            options.Listen(IPAddress.Loopback, 0);
            options.Limits.MaxRequestBodySize = 32 * 1024;
        });
        builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor();
        ConfigureTools(builder.Services, registry, dispatcher);

        var app = builder.Build();
        var host = new LoopbackMcpHost(app, scope);
        app.Use(host.AuthenticateAsync);
        app.MapMcp("/mcp");
        try
        {
            await app.StartAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return host;
        }
        catch
        {
            await host.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
            throw;
        }
    }

    private static void ConfigureTools(IServiceCollection services, FeatureRegistry registry, IWorkbenchDispatcher dispatcher)
    {
        var features = registry.Features.ToDictionary(feature => feature.ToolName, StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var tools = registry.Features.Select(feature =>
        {
            var schemas = registry.Describe(feature);
            return new Tool
            {
                Name = feature.ToolName,
                Description = feature.Description,
                InputSchema = schemas.InputSchema,
                OutputSchema = schemas.OutputSchema,
                Annotations = new ToolAnnotations
                {
                    ReadOnlyHint = !feature.IsMutation,
                    DestructiveHint = false,
                    OpenWorldHint = false,
                },
            };
        }).ToArray();

        services.AddMcpServer(options => options.ServerInfo = new Implementation { Name = "retro-ide", Version = "0.1" })
            .WithHttpTransport(options => options.Stateless = true)
            .WithListToolsHandler((_, _) => ValueTask.FromResult(new ListToolsResult { Tools = tools.ToList() }))
            .WithCallToolHandler(async (request, token) =>
            {
                var operation = Guid.NewGuid();
                var provider = request.Server.Services!;
                var http = provider.GetRequiredService<IHttpContextAccessor>().HttpContext;
                if (http?.Items[GrantKey] is not ActorGrant grant)
                    return ToWire(OperationResult.Failure(operation, "unauthorized", "Authentication is required."));

                var args = request.Params;
                var feature = args is not null && features.TryGetValue(args.Name, out var found) ? found : null;
                var result = feature is null
                    ? OperationResult.Failure(operation, "tool_unavailable", "The requested tool is unavailable.")
                    : await feature.InvokeAsync(dispatcher, registry.Context, args!.Arguments, grant, operation, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                Audit(provider.GetRequiredService<ILogger<LoopbackMcpHost>>(), feature?.ToolName ?? "<unknown>",
                    grant.Actor, grant.WorkspaceId, grant.ViewKey, operation, result.Code);
                return ToWire(result);
            });
    }

    /// <summary>Issues a revocable grant for the selected view, with a distinct per-client secret.</summary>
    public AttachmentDescriptor CreateAttachment(string actor, bool canMutate)
    {
        if (actor.Length is < 1 or > 64 || !actor.All(c => char.IsAsciiLetterOrDigit(c) || c is '.' or '-' or '_'))
            throw new ArgumentException("Use a stable actor ID containing letters, digits, '.', '-' or '_'.", nameof(actor));

        lock (_lifecycle)
        {
            ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
            var descriptor = new AttachmentDescriptor(_endpoint(), Convert.ToHexString(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(32)));
            if (!_grants.TryAdd(TokenKey(descriptor.Token), new ActorGrant(actor, _scope.WorkspaceId, _scope.ViewKey, canMutate)))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not issue an MCP attachment.");
            return descriptor;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Revokes an issued descriptor, including queued operations.</summary>
    public void Revoke(AttachmentDescriptor descriptor)
    {
        if (_grants.TryGetValue(TokenKey(descriptor.Token), out var grant))
        {
            grant.Revoke();
            _grants.TryRemove(TokenKey(descriptor.Token), out _);
        }
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        lock (_lifecycle)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;
            _disposed = true;
            foreach (var grant in _grants.Values)
                grant.Revoke();
            _grants.Clear();
        }

        try { await _app.StopAsync().ConfigureAwait(false); }
        finally { await _app.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false); }
    }

    private Task AuthenticateAsync(HttpContext context, RequestDelegate next)
    {
        var expectedHost = context.Connection.LocalIpAddress?.ToString() + ":" + context.Connection.LocalPort.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        var origins = context.Request.Headers.Origin;
        if (context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress is not { } remote || !IPAddress.IsLoopback(remote) ||
            !string.Equals(context.Request.Host.Value, expectedHost, StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
            (origins.Count != 0 && (origins.Count != 1 || !string.Equals(origins[0], "http://" + expectedHost, StringComparison.Ordinal))))
        {
            context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden;
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        if (context.Request.Headers.Authorization.Count != 1 ||
            !AuthenticationHeaderValue.TryParse(context.Request.Headers.Authorization[0], out var header) ||
            !string.Equals(header.Scheme, "Bearer", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            header.Parameter is not { Length: 64 } token || !token.All(char.IsAsciiHexDigit) ||
            !_grants.TryGetValue(TokenKey(token), out var grant) || !grant.IsActive)
        {
            context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized;
            context.Response.Headers.WWWAuthenticate = "Bearer";
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        context.Items[GrantKey] = grant;
        return next(context);
    }

    private static string TokenKey(string token) => Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(Convert.FromHexString(token)));

    private static CallToolResult ToWire(OperationResult result) => new()
    {
        IsError = !string.Equals(result.Code, "ok", StringComparison.Ordinal),
        Content = [new TextContentBlock { Text = result.Summary }],
        StructuredContent = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(result, WireJson.Options),
    };

    [LoggerMessage(Level = LogLevel.Information, Message = "MCP {Tool} actor={Actor} workspace={Workspace} view={View} operation={Operation} outcome={Outcome}")]
    private static partial void Audit(ILogger logger, string tool, string actor, Guid workspace, Guid view, Guid operation, string outcome);
}

        {

            new ShellTool("registers", "Registers", "No debugger session connected.", "right", interaction),
            new ShellTool("call-stack", "Call Stack", "No debugger session connected.", "right", interaction),
            new ShellTool("output", "Output", "Workbench ready.", "bottom", interaction),

    public string? ActiveToolId { get; private set; }

            .Select(window =>

    private bool Compatible(WorkbenchLayoutState? layout)
    {
        if (layout is not { Version: 1, Main: not null, Floating.Length: <= 12 } || layout.Main.Content is null)
            return false;

        var ids = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        return VisitBranch(layout.Main) && layout.Floating.All(VisitBranch) && ids.SetEquals(_tools.Keys.Concat(_documents.Keys)) &&
            (layout.ActiveTool is null || _tools.ContainsKey(layout.ActiveTool));

        bool VisitBranch(DockBranch branch) =>
            branch is { Pinned: not null, Content.Kind: "vertical" or "horizontal" or "tool-tabs" or "document-tabs" } &&
            Visit(branch.Content, 0) && branch.Pinned.All(item =>
                item is { Tool: not null, Alignment: "Left" or "Right" or "Top" or "Bottom" } &&
                _tools.ContainsKey(item.Tool) && ids.Add(item.Tool));

        bool Visit(DockNode? node, int depth)
        {
            if (node is null || depth > 24)
                return false;
            return node.Kind switch
            {
                "tool" => node.Id is not null && _tools.ContainsKey(node.Id) && ids.Add(node.Id),
                "document" => node.Id is not null && _documents.ContainsKey(node.Id) && ids.Add(node.Id),
                "horizontal" or "vertical" =>
                    node.Children is { Length: <= 24 } && node.Children.All(child =>
                        child is { Kind: not ("tool" or "document") } && Visit(child, depth + 1)),
                "tool-tabs" or "document-tabs" =>
                    node.Children is { Length: <= 24 } && node.Children.All(child =>
                        child is { Kind: "tool" or "document" } && Visit(child, depth + 1)),
                "splitter" => true,
                _ => false,
            };
        }

    private IRootDock CreateRoot(IDockable content, PinnedTool[] pins)
    {
        var root = Factory.CreateRootDock();
        root.Id = "root";
        root.Context = _workspace;
        root.IsCollapsable = false;
        root.FloatingWindowHostMode = DockFloatingWindowHostMode.Native;
        root.VisibleDockables = Factory.CreateList(content);
        root.ActiveDockable = content;
        root.DefaultDockable = content;
        RestorePinned(root, pins);
        return root;
    }

    private IDockable Build(DockNode node)
    {
        switch (node.Kind)
        {
            case "tool": return _tools[node.Id!];
            case "document": return _documents[node.Id!];
            case "splitter": return new ProportionalDockSplitter { CanResize = true, ResizePreview = true };
        }

        IDock dock = node.Kind switch
        {
            "tool-tabs" => new ToolDock { Alignment = ParseAlignment(node.Alignment), GripMode = GripMode.Visible },
            "document-tabs" => new DocumentDock { EnableWindowDrag = true },
            _ => new ProportionalDock
            {
                Orientation = string.Equals(node.Kind, "horizontal", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? Orientation.Horizontal : Orientation.Vertical,
            },
        };
        dock.Id = GroupId(node.Id) ?? string.Empty;
        dock.IsCollapsable = false;
        if (node.Proportion is > 0 and <= 1)
            dock.Proportion = node.Proportion.Value;
        dock.VisibleDockables = Factory.CreateList(node.Children!.Select(Build).ToArray());
        dock.ActiveDockable = dock.VisibleDockables.FirstOrDefault(child => string.Equals(child.Id, node.Active, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            ?? dock.VisibleDockables.FirstOrDefault(child => child is not ISplitter);
        return dock;

    private static DockBranch CaptureBranch(IRootDock root)
    {

            .Concat(PinList(root.RightPinnedDockables, Alignment.Right))
            .Concat(PinList(root.TopPinnedDockables, Alignment.Top))
            .Concat(PinList(root.BottomPinnedDockables, Alignment.Bottom)).ToArray();
        var body = root.VisibleDockables!.First(child => child is IDock);

        IEnumerable<PinnedTool> PinList(IList<IDockable>? dockables, Alignment alignment) =>

            IToolDock tools => CaptureGroup(tools, "tool-tabs", tools.Alignment.ToString()),
            IDocumentDock documents => CaptureGroup(documents, "document-tabs"),
            IDock fallback => CaptureGroup(fallback, "tool-tabs"),
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Unsupported workbench dockable."),

        DockNode CaptureGroup(IDock dock, string kind, string? alignment = null) =>
            new(kind, CapturedId(dock), dock.Proportion is > 0 and <= 1 ? dock.Proportion : null,
                CapturedId(dock.ActiveDockable), dock.VisibleDockables?.Select(CaptureNode).ToArray() ?? [], alignment);
    }

    private static Dictionary<IToolDock, string> CaptureToolGroupIds(IRootDock root)
    {
        var docks = Descendants(root).OfType<IDock>().ToArray();
        var existingIds = docks.Select(dock => dock.Id).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var assignedIds = docks.Where(dock => dock is not IToolDock).Select(dock => dock.Id).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var groupIds = new Dictionary<IToolDock, string>(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance);
        var suffix = 0;

        // Dock can leave newly split groups unnamed or copy an existing ID. Give
        // each group a unique saved ID so pins can reference it by identity.
        foreach (var group in docks.OfType<IToolDock>())
        {
            var id = GroupId(group.Id);
            if (id is null || !assignedIds.Add(id))
            {
                do { id = FormattableString.Invariant($"tool-group-{++suffix}"); }
                while (!existingIds.Add(id));
            }
            groupIds.Add(group, id);
        }

        return groupIds;
    }

    private void RestorePinned(IRootDock root, PinnedTool[] pins)
    {
        var owners = Descendants(root).OfType<IToolDock>().ToArray();
        // Dock initializes pinned tools from the root's edge lists. A missing original
        // dock is valid: Dock can find or create an aligned destination when unpinning.
        foreach (var edge in pins.GroupBy(pin => ParseAlignment(pin.Alignment)))
        {
            var pinned = Factory.CreateList<IDockable>();
            foreach (var pin in edge)
            {
                var tool = _tools[pin.Tool];
                tool.OriginalOwner = owners.FirstOrDefault(owner => owner.Alignment == edge.Key &&
                    string.Equals(owner.Id, pin.Group, StringComparison.Ordinal));
                pinned.Add(tool);
            }

            switch (edge.Key)
            {
                case Alignment.Left: root.LeftPinnedDockables = pinned; break;
                case Alignment.Right: root.RightPinnedDockables = pinned; break;
                case Alignment.Top: root.TopPinnedDockables = pinned; break;
                case Alignment.Bottom: root.BottomPinnedDockables = pinned; break;
            }
        }
    }

    private void RestoreLostPanes()
    {
        if (_disposed)
            return;

        foreach (var tool in _tools.Values.Where(tool => Factory.FindRoot(tool) is not { } root ||
            (!ReferenceEquals(root, Root) && root.Window?.Owner is null)))
        {
            var owner = Descendants(Root).OfType<IToolDock>()
                .FirstOrDefault(group => string.Equals(group.Id, tool.DefaultGroup, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                ?? CreateRecoveryGroup(tool.DefaultGroup);
            Factory.AddDockable(owner, tool);
            owner.ActiveDockable ??= tool;
        }
    }

    private IToolDock CreateRecoveryGroup(string id)
    {
        var (alignment, operation) = id switch
        {
            "left" => (Alignment.Left, DockOperation.Left),
            "bottom" => (Alignment.Bottom, DockOperation.Bottom),
            _ => (Alignment.Right, DockOperation.Right),
        };
        var owner = Factory.CreateToolDock();
        owner.Id = id;
        owner.Alignment = alignment;
        var anchor = Descendants(Root).OfType<IDocumentDock>().FirstOrDefault() as IDock
            ?? Root.VisibleDockables!.OfType<IDock>().First();
        Factory.SplitToDock(anchor, owner, operation);
        return owner;
    }

    private void Publish(string? id)
    {
        ActiveToolId = id;
        if (!_suppress)
        {
            Revision++;
            Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        }
    }

    private static double? Size(double size) => double.IsFinite(size) && size > 0 ? size : null;

    private static string? GroupId(string? id) =>
        id is { Length: > 0 and <= 128 } && id.All(static character => char.IsAsciiLetterOrDigit(character) || character is '-' or '_' or '.')
            ? id : null;

using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Data;
using Avalonia.Input;
using Avalonia.Threading;

namespace RetroIde.Workbench;

/// <summary>Tracks logically blocked workbench scopes and applies the platform wait cursor to their live surfaces.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-007#ac-test-system-wait-cursor</remarks>
public sealed class InteractionBlocks : IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>Identifies every workbench content surface, including floating panes.</summary>
    public const string WorkbenchScope = "workbench";

    private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _operations = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private Cursor? _wait;
    private bool _disposed;

    internal event EventHandler? Changed;

    /// <summary>Reports whether any active operation blocks the scope.</summary>
    public bool IsBlocked(string scope)
    {
        Dispatcher.UIThread.VerifyAccess();
        return _operations.ContainsKey(scope) || _operations.ContainsKey(WorkbenchScope);
    }

    /// <summary>Invokes the operation on the thread pool and tracks its optional block on the UI dispatcher.</summary>
    public async Task RunAsync(string? blockedScope, Func<CancellationToken, Task> operation, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (blockedScope is not null)
        {
            if (Dispatcher.UIThread.CheckAccess())
                Begin(blockedScope);
            else
                await Dispatcher.UIThread.InvokeAsync(() => Begin(blockedScope));
        }

        try { await Task.Run(() => operation(cancellationToken), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false); }
        finally
        {
            if (blockedScope is not null)
                await Dispatcher.UIThread.InvokeAsync(() => End(blockedScope));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Applies the wait override to a surface for its attached lifetime.</summary>
    public IDisposable Attach(string scope, Control surface)
    {
        Dispatcher.UIThread.VerifyAccess();
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
        return new SurfaceSubscription(this, scope, surface);
    }

    internal Control Wrap(string scope, Control content)
    {
        var overlay = new Border
        {
            Name = "InteractionSurface",
            Background = Avalonia.Media.Brushes.Transparent,
            IsVisible = false,
        };
        var region = new Grid { Children = { content, overlay } };
        IDisposable? subscription = null;
        region.AttachedToVisualTree += (_, _) => subscription = Attach(scope, overlay);
        region.DetachedFromVisualTree += (_, _) =>
        {
            subscription?.Dispose();
            subscription = null;
        };
        IDisposable? inputOverride = null;
        overlay.PropertyChanged += (_, args) =>
        {
            if (args.Property == InputElement.CursorProperty)
            {
                overlay.IsVisible = overlay.Cursor is not null;
                if (overlay.IsVisible)
                    inputOverride ??= content.SetValue(InputElement.IsEnabledProperty, false, BindingPriority.Animation);
                else
                {
                    inputOverride?.Dispose();
                    inputOverride = null;
                }
            }
        };
        return region;
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public void Dispose()
    {
        Dispatcher.UIThread.VerifyAccess();
        if (_disposed)
            return;

        _disposed = true;
        _operations.Clear();
        Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        _wait?.Dispose();
    }

    private void Begin(string scope)
    {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
        _operations[scope] = _operations.GetValueOrDefault(scope) + 1;
        Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }

    private void End(string scope)
    {
        if (!_operations.TryGetValue(scope, out var count))
            return;
        if (count == 1)
            _operations.Remove(scope);
        else
            _operations[scope] = count - 1;
        Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }

    private sealed class SurfaceSubscription : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly InteractionBlocks _blocks;
        private readonly string _scope;
        private readonly Control _surface;
        private IDisposable? _cursorOverride;

        public SurfaceSubscription(InteractionBlocks blocks, string scope, Control surface)
        {
            _blocks = blocks;
            _scope = scope;
            _surface = surface;
            _blocks.Changed += Update;
            Update(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            Dispatcher.UIThread.VerifyAccess();
            _blocks.Changed -= Update;
            _cursorOverride?.Dispose();
            _cursorOverride = null;
        }

        private void Update(object? sender, EventArgs args)
        {
            if (_blocks.IsBlocked(_scope))
            {
                var wait = _blocks._wait ??= new Cursor(StandardCursorType.Wait);
                _cursorOverride ??= _surface.SetValue(InputElement.CursorProperty, wait, BindingPriority.Animation);
            }
            else
            {
                _cursorOverride?.Dispose();
                _cursorOverride = null;
            }
        }
    }
}

                Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData, Environment.SpecialFolderOption.DoNotVerify), "RetroIde");

            var session = new WorkbenchSession(Guid.NewGuid(), layouts.Load());
            var window = new WorkbenchWindow(session, layouts);
            desktop.MainWindow = window;
            var monitor = desktop.Args?.Contains("--mcp", StringComparer.Ordinal) == true;
            var mutate = desktop.Args?.Contains("--mcp-mutate", StringComparer.Ordinal) == true;

            host = await LoopbackMcpHost.StartAsync(session.Registry, session.Controller, session.View.Address, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            var directory = Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(folder, "attachments")).FullName;
            var path = Path.Combine(directory, $"{session.View.ViewKey:N}.json");
            var descriptor = host.CreateAttachment(mutate ? "local-editor" : "local-observer", canMutate: mutate);
            descriptor.Write(path);
            writtenPath = path;
            token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            var running = new RunningMcp(host, path);
            Avalonia.Threading.Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() => window.ShowAttachmentPaths($"MCP attachment file  {path}"));

        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (token.IsCancellationRequested) { }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or InvalidOperationException or System.Net.Sockets.SocketException)
        {
            Avalonia.Threading.Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() => window.ShowAttachmentPaths("Unable to start the local MCP attachment."));
        }
        finally
        {
            if (host is not null)
            {
                try { await host.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false); }
                finally
                {
                    if (writtenPath is not null)
                        DeleteAttachment(writtenPath);
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static void DeleteAttachment(string path)
    {
        try { File.Delete(path); }
        catch (IOException) { }
        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
    }

                new TextBlock { Text = message, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, Opacity = 0.75 },

using Avalonia.Threading;
using GPS.SimpleMVC.Controllers;
using RetroIde.Application;

namespace RetroIde.Workbench;

/// <summary>Owns workbench view registrations and the shared typed dispatch entry point.</summary>
/// <remarks>TEST-RETRO-007#ac-test-simplemvc-views; TEST-RETRO-007#ac-test-view-result-routing</remarks>
public sealed class WorkbenchController : SimpleControllerBase, IWorkbenchDispatcher
{
    private readonly Guid _workspaceId;
    private readonly DockLayout _layout;
    private readonly InteractionBlocks _interaction;
    private readonly FeatureRegistry _registry;
    private readonly WorkbenchUnitOfWork _unitOfWork;
    private readonly Dictionary<Guid, Registration> _views = [];
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _shutdown = new();
    private bool _disposed;

    internal WorkbenchController(Guid workspaceId, DockLayout layout, InteractionBlocks interaction, FeatureRegistry registry)
    {
        _workspaceId = workspaceId;
        _registry = registry;
        _layout = layout;
        _interaction = interaction;
        _unitOfWork = new WorkbenchUnitOfWork(registry.Context, Resolve);
        Initialize();
        _layout.Changed += RefreshViews;
        _interaction.Changed += RefreshViews;
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public override bool Initialize() => true;

    internal int DispatchCount { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Registers the ViewModel directly with SimpleMVC and subscribes once.</summary>
    public void Register(WorkbenchViewModel view)
    {
        Dispatcher.UIThread.VerifyAccess();
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
        if (view.WorkspaceId != _workspaceId)
            throw new ArgumentException("The view belongs to a different workspace.", nameof(view));
        if (Resolve(view.ViewKey)?.View == view)
            return;
        if (view.RegisteredOnce)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("A closed ViewModel cannot be registered again.");

        if (!AddOrUpdateView(view))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not register the workbench view.");

        view.RegisteredOnce = true;
        var grant = new ActorGrant("workbench", view.WorkspaceId, view.ViewKey, canMutate: true);
        _views.Add(view.ViewKey, new Registration(view, grant, this));
        view.CommandRequested += OnCommandRequested;
        view.SetFocusRoute(_registry.FocusTool.Id, CanFocus);
        view.Update(_layout.ActiveToolId, _layout.Revision);
    }

    /// <summary>Detaches command events and invalidates the registration's authority.</summary>
    public void Unregister(WorkbenchViewModel view)
    {
        Dispatcher.UIThread.VerifyAccess();
        if (!_views.Remove(view.ViewKey, out var registration))
            return;

        registration.Grant.Revoke();
        view.CommandRequested -= OnCommandRequested;
        RemoveView(view);
        view.SetFocusRoute(null, null);
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async Task<OperationResult> DispatchAsync<TInput>(Feature<TInput> feature, TInput input, WorkbenchAddress? context,
        ActorGrant actor, Guid operationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken) where TInput : class
    {
        try
        {
            return await Dispatcher.UIThread.InvokeAsync(() =>
            {
                DispatchCount++;
                return _unitOfWork.Execute(feature, input, context, actor, operationId, cancellationToken);
            }, DispatcherPriority.Background, _shutdown.Token).GetTask().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is OperationCanceledException or ObjectDisposedException && _disposed)
        {
            return OperationResult.Failure(operationId, "view_closed", "The workbench has closed.");
        }
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
    {
        if (!disposing || _disposed)
        {
            base.Dispose(disposing);
            return;
        }

        Dispatcher.UIThread.VerifyAccess();
        _disposed = true;
        _shutdown.Cancel();
        _shutdown.Dispose();

        _layout.Changed -= RefreshViews;
        _interaction.Changed -= RefreshViews;
        foreach (var registration in _views.Values.ToArray())
            Unregister(registration.View);
        base.Dispose(disposing);
    }

    private bool CanFocus(string toolId) => !_interaction.IsBlocked(toolId) && _layout.CanFocus(toolId);

    private Registration? Resolve(Guid viewKey)
    {
        return _views.TryGetValue(viewKey, out var registration) &&
            ReferenceEquals(registration.View, GetView<IView>(viewKey)) ? registration : null;
    }

    private void RefreshViews(object? sender, EventArgs args)
    {
        foreach (var registration in _views.Values.ToArray())
            registration.View.Update(_layout.ActiveToolId, _layout.Revision);
    }

    private void OnCommandRequested(object? sender, ViewCommandRequested request)
    {
        if (request.Completion is null && Resolve(request.Context.ViewKey) is { } registration &&
            ReferenceEquals(sender, registration.View) && string.Equals(request.CommandId, _registry.FocusTool.Id, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            request.Completion = DispatchToViewAsync(registration, request);
    }

    private async Task DispatchToViewAsync(Registration origin, ViewCommandRequested request)
    {
        var result = await DispatchAsync(_registry.FocusTool, request.Input, request.Context, origin.Grant,
            request.RequestId, request.CancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);

        await Dispatcher.UIThread.InvokeAsync(() =>
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(Resolve(origin.View.ViewKey), origin))
                origin.View.Receive(result);
        }, DispatcherPriority.Background).GetTask().ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    private sealed record Registration(WorkbenchViewModel View, ActorGrant Grant, WorkbenchController Controller) : IWorkbenchRegistration
    {
        public WorkbenchAddress Address => View.Address;
        public object ContextSource => View;
        public bool TryFocus(string toolId) => Controller.CanFocus(toolId) && Controller._layout.Focus(toolId);
    }
}

    public string CommandId { get; } = commandId;

    }

    [McpContext]
    public Guid ViewKey { get; } = Guid.NewGuid();

    /// <summary>Gets the current workspace's identity.</summary>
    [McpContext]
    public Guid WorkspaceId { get; }

    /// <summary>Gets the currently focused tool pane, if one has been focused.</summary>
    [McpContext]
    public string? ActiveToolId => _activeToolId;

    /// <summary>Gets the revision of the workbench selection state.</summary>
    [McpContext]
    public long WorkbenchRevision => _workbenchRevision;

    /// <summary>Gets or sets the target selected in the focus command bar.</summary>
    [ObservableProperty]
    [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor(nameof(FocusCommand))]
    public partial string? FocusTarget { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Gets the last correlated UI result.</summary>
    [ObservableProperty]
    public partial OperationResult? LastResult { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Gets the current typed registration address.</summary>
    public WorkbenchAddress Address => new(ViewKey, WorkspaceId, ActiveToolId, WorkbenchRevision);

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public event EventHandler<ViewCommandRequested>? CommandRequested;

    {
        if (revision < _workbenchRevision)
            return;

        var revisionChanged = _workbenchRevision != revision;
        var toolChanged = !string.Equals(_activeToolId, activeTool, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        if (revisionChanged)
            OnPropertyChanging(nameof(WorkbenchRevision));
        if (toolChanged)
            OnPropertyChanging(nameof(ActiveToolId));

        // A changing observer can synchronously issue a newer Dock selection.
        if (revision < _workbenchRevision)
            return;

        _workbenchRevision = revision;
        _activeToolId = activeTool;

        if (revisionChanged)
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(WorkbenchRevision));
        if (toolChanged)
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ActiveToolId));
        FocusCommand.NotifyCanExecuteChanged();
    }

    internal void SetFocusRoute(string? commandId, Func<string, bool>? canFocus)
    {
        _commandId = commandId;
        _canFocus = canFocus;
        FocusCommand.NotifyCanExecuteChanged();
    }

    private bool CanFocus() => FocusTarget is { } target && _canFocus?.Invoke(target) == true;

    private async Task FocusAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        Dispatcher.UIThread.VerifyAccess();
        if (!CanFocus() || FocusTarget is not { } target || _commandId is null)
            return;

        var request = new ViewCommandRequested(Guid.NewGuid(), _commandId, Address, new FocusToolInput(target), cancellationToken);
        CommandRequested?.Invoke(this, request);
        if (request.Completion is { } completion)
            await completion.ConfigureAwait(true);
        else
            Receive(OperationResult.Failure(request.RequestId, "view_closed", "The workbench registration is no longer live."));
    }
}

    /// <summary>Creates the desktop presentation for a live workbench session.</summary>
    public WorkbenchWindow(WorkbenchSession session, LayoutStore? layouts = null)
    {

        DataContext = session.View;
        Title = "Retro IDE";
        Width = 1200;
        Height = 780;

        MinHeight = 480;

        var focusCommand = session.View.FocusCommand;

        {

        {

        // Dock initializes its locator when the layout is created, before the workbench binds commands.

    {

            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Conflicting shortcut in the workbench scope: {gesture}");
