        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine("Unable to save the Retro IDE layout.");
        }
        finally
        {
            // A fast save or a synchronous failure can complete inside the original close callback.
            await Dispatcher.Yield(DispatcherPriority.Background);
            _closeSave = null;
            closeSave.Dispose();
        }

        if (_closed)

        try { Close(); }
        finally { _replayingClose = false; }
    }

        {

            Spacing = 8,
            Margin = new Thickness(10, 6),

        shell.Children.Add(commandBar);
        shell.Children.Add(status);
        var dockRegion = session.Interaction.Wrap(InteractionBlocks.WorkbenchScope, dock);
        shell.Children.Add(dockRegion);
        return shell;
    }

    internal MenuItem FocusMenu { get; }
    internal Button FocusButton { get; }
    internal KeyBinding FocusShortcut { get; }
    internal TextBlock FocusButtonLabel { get; }
    internal TextBlock FocusButtonShortcut { get; }
    internal PathIcon FocusButtonIcon { get; }
    internal CommandPresentation CommandPresentation { get; }

    internal void ShowAttachmentPaths(string message)
    {

        var panel = (DockPanel)Content!;

        panel.Children.Insert(2, label);
    }

    /// <summary>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-scope</summary>
    [AvaloniaFact]
    public async Task Disconnecting_an_authenticated_HTTP_mutation_while_queued_prevents_focus()
    {
        using var session = new WorkbenchSession(Guid.NewGuid());
        Assert.True(session.Layout.Focus("registers"));
        var dispatcher = new QueuedMutation(session.Controller);
        using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15));
        using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
        await using var host = await LoopbackMcpHost.StartAsync(session.Registry, dispatcher, session.View.Address, timeout.Token);
        var attachment = host.CreateAttachment("disconnect-editor", canMutate: true);
        using var transport = attachment.CreateHttpClient();
        await using var client = await ConnectHttp(attachment.Endpoint, transport, timeout.Token);
        var before = session.View.Address;
        var context = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(before, WireJson.Options);
        var pending = Call(client, "workbench_focus_tool", Focus(context, "output"), cancellation.Token).AsTask();
        try
        {
            var operation = await dispatcher.Entered.Task.WaitAsync(timeout.Token);
            await cancellation.CancelAsync();
            await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<OperationCanceledException>(() => pending);
            await dispatcher.Cancelled.Task.WaitAsync(timeout.Token);
            dispatcher.Release.TrySetResult();
            var result = await dispatcher.Completed.Task.WaitAsync(timeout.Token);
            Assert.Equal(operation, result.OperationId);
            Assert.Equal("cancelled", result.Code);
            Assert.Equal(before, session.View.Address);
            Assert.True(session.Layout.IsFocused("registers"));
        }
        finally { dispatcher.Release.TrySetResult(); }
    }

    private sealed class QueuedMutation(WorkbenchController controller) : IWorkbenchDispatcher
    {
        public TaskCompletionSource<Guid> Entered { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        public TaskCompletionSource Release { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        public TaskCompletionSource Cancelled { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        public TaskCompletionSource<OperationResult> Completed { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        public async Task<OperationResult> DispatchAsync<TInput>(Feature<TInput> feature, TInput input, WorkbenchAddress? context,
            ActorGrant actor, Guid operationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken) where TInput : class
        {
            using var cancellation = cancellationToken.Register(() => Cancelled.TrySetResult());
            Entered.SetResult(operationId);
            await Release.Task.ConfigureAwait(false);
            var result = await controller.DispatchAsync(feature, input, context, actor, operationId, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Completed.TrySetResult(result);
            return result;
        }
    }

    private static Task<McpClient> ConnectHttp(Uri endpoint, HttpClient http, CancellationToken token) =>
        McpClient.CreateAsync(new HttpClientTransport(new() { Endpoint = endpoint, TransportMode = HttpTransportMode.StreamableHttp }, http), cancellationToken: token);

    private static ValueTask<CallToolResult> Call(McpClient client, string name, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>? args, CancellationToken token) =>
        client.CallToolAsync(name, args, cancellationToken: token);

    private static Dictionary<string, object?> Focus(JsonElement context, string tool) =>
        new(StringComparer.Ordinal) { ["context"] = context, ["toolId"] = tool };

    private static JsonElement Context(CallToolResult result) => result.StructuredContent!.Value.GetProperty("context");
    private static string? Code(CallToolResult result) => result.StructuredContent!.Value.GetProperty("code").GetString();
}

    /// <summary>TEST-RETRO-001#verify-ac-behavior-desktop-2</summary>
    [AvaloniaTheory]
    [InlineData("", "", Alignment.Right)]
    [InlineData("", "", Alignment.Unset)]
    [InlineData("right", "right", Alignment.Right)]
    [InlineData("right", "debug/tools #23", Alignment.Right)]
    [InlineData("right", "debug-tools-23", Alignment.Right)]
    public void Pinned_tool_roundtrips_its_surviving_dynamic_owner(string existingId, string dynamicId, Alignment alignment)
    {
        var folder = Directory.CreateTempSubdirectory();
        try
        {
            var store = new LayoutStore(Path.Combine(folder.FullName, "layout.json"));
            var workspaceId = Guid.NewGuid();
            using (var before = new WorkbenchSession(workspaceId))
            {
                var factory = before.Layout.Factory;
                var existing = Assert.IsAssignableFrom<IToolDock>(before.Layout.Tool("registers").Owner);
                existing.Id = existingId;
                var split = factory.CreateToolDock();
                split.Id = dynamicId;
                split.Alignment = alignment;
                factory.SplitToDock(existing, split, DockOperation.Right);
                var output = before.Layout.Tool("output");
                var problems = before.Layout.Tool("problems");
                var source = Assert.IsAssignableFrom<IDock>(output.Owner);
                factory.MoveDockable(source, split, output, null);
                factory.MoveDockable(source, split, problems, output);
                Assert.Same(split, problems.Owner);
                factory.PinDockable(output);
                Assert.True(factory.IsDockablePinned(output));
                store.Save(before.Layout.Capture());
            }

            var saved = Assert.IsType<WorkbenchLayoutState>(store.Load());
            var pin = Assert.Single(saved.Main.Pinned);
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty(pin.Group));
            if (string.Equals(dynamicId, "debug-tools-23", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                Assert.Equal(dynamicId, pin.Group);
            if (string.Equals(dynamicId, "debug/tools #23", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                Assert.DoesNotContain(dynamicId, File.ReadAllText(store.Path), StringComparison.Ordinal);
            using var after = new WorkbenchSession(workspaceId, saved);
            var restored = after.Layout.Tool("output");
            var splitOwner = after.Layout.Tool("problems").Owner;
            Assert.Same(splitOwner, restored.OriginalOwner);
            Assert.Equal(pin, Assert.Single(after.Layout.Capture().Main.Pinned));
            after.Layout.Factory.UnpinDockable(restored);
            Assert.Same(splitOwner, restored.Owner);
        }
        finally { folder.Delete(recursive: true); }
    }

internal static class NativeDockingTests
{
    [STAThread]
    private static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        try
        {
            if (args is ["--remote-control-desktop"])
                return RemoteControlDesktop.Run();
            if (args is not ([] or ["--remote-control"]))
                throw new ArgumentException("Use --remote-control to run without desktop keyboard or mouse input.");

            var remoteControl = args.Length != 0;
            var app = remoteControl ? RemoteControlDesktop.BuildApp() : AppBuilder.Configure<WorkbenchApp>().UsePlatformDetect();
            app.SetupWithoutStarting();
            using var finished = new CancellationTokenSource();
            var result = remoteControl ? RemoteControlDockingTests.RunAsync(finished) : RunAsync(finished);
            Dispatcher.UIThread.MainLoop(finished.Token);
            result.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            Task.Run(() => ProductionAttachmentTests.RunAsync(useNativeShortcut: !remoteControl)).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            return 0;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine(ex);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// TEST-RETRO-001#verify-ac-behavior-desktop-1
    /// TEST-RETRO-001#verify-ac-contract-desktop-1
    /// TEST-RETRO-007#ac-test-system-wait-cursor
    /// TEST-RETRO-008#ac-test-gesture-parity
    /// </summary>
    private static async Task RunAsync(CancellationTokenSource finished)
    {
        try
        {
            using var input = new NativeInput();
            using var session = new WorkbenchSession(Guid.NewGuid());
            var window = new WorkbenchWindow(session) { Topmost = OperatingSystem.IsWindows() };
            var workArea = FitTestWindow(window);
            window.Show();
            try
            {
                await UntilAsync(() => window.IsVisible && window.FocusButton.Bounds.Width > 0, "main workbench").ConfigureAwait(true);
                Console.WriteLine($"Native backend: {window.TryGetPlatformHandle()?.HandleDescriptor}; input: {input.Backend}");
                await InvokeWorkbenchBindingsAsync(input, window, session).ConfigureAwait(true);
                await DragToolAsync(input, window, session, workArea).ConfigureAwait(true);
            }
            finally { window.Close(); }
        }
        finally { await finished.CancelAsync(); }
    }

    private static PixelRect FitTestWindow(Window window)
    {
        var screen = window.Screens.Primary ?? window.Screens.All.FirstOrDefault()
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The native test requires a screen.");
        var area = screen.WorkingArea;
        var scale = screen.Scaling;
        // Reserve room for the native frame and a pointer target beyond the right edge.
        var width = Math.Min(930, Math.Floor(area.Width / scale) - 40);
        var height = Math.Min(630, Math.Floor(area.Height / scale) - 64);
        Require(width >= window.MinWidth && height >= window.MinHeight,
            $"The desktop work area {area} at scale {scale} is too small for the native docking test.");
        window.Width = width;
        window.Height = height;
        var inset = (int)Math.Ceiling(8 * scale);
        window.Position = new PixelPoint(area.X + inset, area.Y + inset);
        return area;
    }

    private static async Task InvokeWorkbenchBindingsAsync(NativeInput input, WorkbenchWindow window, WorkbenchSession session)
    {
        var toolbar = Center(window.FocusButton);
        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
        {
            input.FocusWindow(window);
            await UntilAsync(() => window.IsActive && NativeInput.IsWin32WindowAt(toolbar, window),
                "foreground workbench toolbar in the interactive desktop").ConfigureAwait(true);
        }
        await input.ClickAsync(toolbar).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await UntilAsync(() => session.Controller.DispatchCount == 1 && session.Layout.IsFocused("registers"), "toolbar focus through native input",
            () => $"Window active {window.IsActive}, button hovered {window.FocusButton.IsPointerOver}, " +
                $"dispatches {session.Controller.DispatchCount}, revision {session.View.WorkbenchRevision}.").ConfigureAwait(true);
        await UntilAsync(() => !session.View.FocusCommand.IsRunning, "toolbar completion").ConfigureAwait(true);
        session.Layout.Focus("output");
        input.FocusWindow(window);
        await input.ShortcutAsync().ConfigureAwait(true);
        await UntilAsync(() => session.Controller.DispatchCount == 2 && session.Layout.IsFocused("registers") && !session.View.FocusCommand.IsRunning, "shortcut focus through native input").ConfigureAwait(true);

        session.Layout.Focus("output");
        var menu = window.GetVisualDescendants().OfType<Menu>().Single();
        var viewMenu = menu.GetVisualDescendants().OfType<MenuItem>().Single(item => Equals(item.Header, "_View"));
        await input.ClickAsync(Center(viewMenu)).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await UntilAsync(() => window.FocusMenu.IsVisible && window.FocusMenu.Bounds.Width > 0, "open View menu").ConfigureAwait(true);
        await input.ClickAsync(Center(window.FocusMenu)).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await UntilAsync(() => session.Controller.DispatchCount == 3 && session.Layout.IsFocused("registers") && !session.View.FocusCommand.IsRunning, "menu focus through native input").ConfigureAwait(true);
        await UntilAsync(() => !menu.IsOpen && !viewMenu.IsSubMenuOpen, "View menu dismissal").ConfigureAwait(true);
        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
        {
            input.FocusWindow(window);
            await UntilAsync(() => window.IsActive, "workbench activation after View menu dismissal").ConfigureAwait(true);
        }
    }

    private static async Task DragToolAsync(NativeInput input, WorkbenchWindow window, WorkbenchSession session, PixelRect workArea)
    {
        var registers = session.Layout.Tool("registers");
        var callStack = session.Layout.Tool("call-stack");
        await SelectCallStackAsync(input, window, registers, callStack, workArea).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await input.ClickAsync(Tab(window, registers)).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await VerifyWaitAsync(session, window, input).ConfigureAwait(true);

        var start = Tab(window, registers);
        var outside = window.PointToScreen(new Point(window.ClientSize.Width + 95, 145));
        var edge = new PixelPoint(Math.Min(outside.X, workArea.Right - 4), outside.Y);
        Require(workArea.ContainsExclusive(edge) && edge.X >= window.PointToScreen(new Point(window.ClientSize.Width + 12, 145)).X,
            $"No reachable tear-away point beside the workbench at {window.Position} in work area {workArea}.");
        await input.DragStartAsync(start).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await input.MoveAsync(edge).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await input.ReleaseAsync().ConfigureAwait(true);

        await UntilAsync(() => session.Layout.Root.Windows is [{ Host: HostWindow { IsVisible: true } }], "native tear-away").ConfigureAwait(true);
        var floating = (HostWindow)session.Layout.Root.Windows!.Single().Host!;
        floating.Topmost = window.Topmost;
        Require(floating.TryGetPlatformHandle() is not null, "Floating pane needs a native handle.");
        Require(floating.TryGetPlatformHandle()!.Handle != window.TryGetPlatformHandle()!.Handle, "Floating pane must use a distinct top-level window.");
        await VerifyWaitAsync(session, floating, input).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await VerifyRestoredFloatAsync(session, window).ConfigureAwait(true);

        var targetTab = FindTab(window, callStack);
        var rightPane = targetTab.FindAncestorOfType<ToolControl>() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing dock target.");
        var target = Center(rightPane);
        input.FocusWindow(floating);
        await input.DragStartAsync(Tab(floating, registers)).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await input.MoveAsync(target).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await input.MoveAsync(new PixelPoint(target.X + 1, target.Y)).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await input.ReleaseAsync().ConfigureAwait(true);

        // XEvent is a union of 24 native longs. Send the same close protocol as an X11 window manager.
        nint* buffer = stackalloc nint[24];

        var message = (XClientMessage*)buffer;

        message->Format = 32;
        message->FirstData = XInternAtom(_display, "WM_DELETE_WINDOW", 0);

        }
        finally { XFree(image); }
    }

            await VerifyProcessRestartAsync(selected.Folder, fromStdio, input, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally { root.Delete(recursive: true); }
    }

    private static async Task VerifyProcessRestartAsync(string folder, WorkbenchAddress previous, NativeInput? input, CancellationToken token)
    {
        await using var reopened = new Desktop(folder, remoteControl: input is null);
        var path = await reopened.WaitForAttachmentAsync(token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var descriptor = AttachmentDescriptor.Read(path);
        using var http = descriptor.CreateHttpClient();
        await using var client = await ConnectAsync(descriptor, http, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var restored = await ReadContextAsync(client, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        Require(restored.ActiveToolId == "registers" && restored.ViewKey != previous.ViewKey,
            "The production process restart did not restore Registers with a fresh registration.");
        await reopened.CloseAsync(input, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await reopened.WaitForExitAsync(token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        Require(!File.Exists(path), "The restarted desktop did not remove its attachment descriptor.");
        Console.WriteLine("A fresh production process restored Registers from the saved layout and published a new ViewModel registration.");
    }

    private static Task<McpClient> ConnectAsync(AttachmentDescriptor descriptor, HttpClient http, CancellationToken token) =>
        McpClient.CreateAsync(new HttpClientTransport(new()
        {
            Endpoint = descriptor.Endpoint,
            TransportMode = HttpTransportMode.StreamableHttp,
            EnableStandaloneGetStream = false,
        }, http), cancellationToken: token);

    private static async Task<WorkbenchAddress> ReadContextAsync(McpClient client, CancellationToken token) =>
        Context(await client.CallToolAsync("workbench_get_context", cancellationToken: token).ConfigureAwait(false));

    private static ValueTask<CallToolResult> CallFocusAsync(McpClient client, WorkbenchAddress address, string tool, CancellationToken token) =>
        client.CallToolAsync("workbench_focus_tool", new Dictionary<string, object?>(StringComparer.Ordinal)
        {
            ["context"] = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new
            {
                viewKey = address.ViewKey,
                workspaceId = address.WorkspaceId,
                activeToolId = address.ActiveToolId,
                workbenchRevision = address.WorkbenchRevision,
            }),
            ["toolId"] = tool,
        }, cancellationToken: token);

    private static async Task<WorkbenchAddress> FocusAsync(McpClient client, WorkbenchAddress before, string tool, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var after = Context(await CallFocusAsync(client, before, tool, token).ConfigureAwait(false));
        CheckFocus(before, after, tool);
        return after;
    }

    private static void CheckFocus(WorkbenchAddress before, WorkbenchAddress after, string tool) =>
        Require(after == before with { ActiveToolId = tool, WorkbenchRevision = before.WorkbenchRevision + 1 },
            $"Expected one focus change to {tool} from {before}, got {after}.");

    private static WorkbenchAddress Context(CallToolResult result)
    {
        Require(Code(result) == "ok", $"Expected a live context, received {result.StructuredContent}.");
        return result.StructuredContent!.Value.GetProperty("context").Deserialize<WorkbenchAddress>(WireJson.Options)!;
    }

    private static string? Code(CallToolResult result) =>
        result.StructuredContent?.GetProperty("code").GetString();

    private static async Task RequireUnavailableAsync(McpClient client, WorkbenchAddress context, string transport, CancellationToken token)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await CallFocusAsync(client, context, "output", token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Require(result.IsError == true && result.StructuredContent is null,
                $"The open {transport} client returned a workbench result after shutdown.");
            Console.WriteLine($"{transport} after shutdown: bridge reported attachment unavailable.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is McpException or HttpRequestException)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{transport} after shutdown: transport unavailable ({ex.GetType().Name}).");
        }
    }

    private static void Require(bool condition, string message)
    {
        if (!condition)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
    }

    private sealed class Desktop : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        private readonly Task<string> _stderr;

        public Desktop(string folder, bool remoteControl)
        {
            Folder = Directory.CreateDirectory(folder).FullName;
            var start = new ProcessStartInfo(Dotnet)
            {
                WorkingDirectory = AppContext.BaseDirectory,
                UseShellExecute = false,
                RedirectStandardError = true,
                RedirectStandardInput = remoteControl,
            };
            start.ArgumentList.Add(remoteControl ? typeof(RemoteControlDesktop).Assembly.Location : typeof(WorkbenchApp).Assembly.Location);
            start.ArgumentList.Add(remoteControl ? "--remote-control-desktop" : "--mcp-mutate");
            start.Environment["RETROIDE_APP_DATA_DIR"] = Folder;
            Process = Process.Start(start) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not launch the production workbench.");
            _stderr = Process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync();
        }

        public string Folder { get; }
        public Process Process { get; }

        public async Task<string> WaitForAttachmentAsync(CancellationToken token)
        {
            var directory = Path.Combine(Folder, "attachments");
            while (!Process.HasExited)
            {
                if (Directory.Exists(directory) && Directory.GetFiles(directory, "*.json").SingleOrDefault() is { } path)
                    return path;
                await Task.Delay(50, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Workbench exited during startup: {await _stderr.ConfigureAwait(false)}");
        }

        public async Task FocusThroughUiAsync(NativeInput? input, CancellationToken token)
        {
            if (input is null)
            {
                await Process.StandardInput.WriteLineAsync("focus".AsMemory(), token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                return;
            }

            input.FocusWindow(await WaitForWindowAsync(input, token).ConfigureAwait(false));
            await input.ShortcutAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task CloseAsync(NativeInput? input, CancellationToken token)
        {
            if (input is null)
                await Process.StandardInput.WriteLineAsync("close".AsMemory(), token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            else
                input.CloseWindow(await WaitForWindowAsync(input, token).ConfigureAwait(false));
        }

        private async Task<nint> WaitForWindowAsync(NativeInput input, CancellationToken token)
        {
            while (!Process.HasExited)
            {
                var handle = input.FindWindow(Process);
                if (handle != 0)
                    return handle;
                await Task.Delay(50, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Workbench exited before finding its native window: {await _stderr.ConfigureAwait(false)}");
        }

        public async Task WaitForExitAsync(CancellationToken token)
        {
            await Process.WaitForExitAsync(token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var stderr = await _stderr.ConfigureAwait(false);
            Require(Process.ExitCode == 0, $"Workbench exited with code {Process.ExitCode}: {stderr}");
        }

        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            using (Process)
            {
                if (!Process.HasExited)
                {
                    Process.Kill(entireProcessTree: true);
                    using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
                    await Process.WaitForExitAsync(timeout.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

using Avalonia.Controls.ApplicationLifetimes;
using Avalonia.Threading;
using RetroIde.Testing;
using RetroIde.Workbench;

namespace RetroIde.NativeTests;

internal static class RemoteControlDesktop
{
    internal static AppBuilder BuildApp()
    {
        var app = AppBuilder.Configure<WorkbenchApp>().UsePlatformDetect();
        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
        {
            // Session 0 has native windows but no hardware composition desktop.
            app.With(new Win32PlatformOptions
            {
                RenderingMode = [Win32RenderingMode.Software],
                CompositionMode = [Win32CompositionMode.RedirectionSurface],
            });
        }
        return app;
    }

    internal static int Run()
    {
        try
        {
            return BuildApp().StartWithClassicDesktopLifetime(["--mcp-mutate"], lifetime =>
                lifetime.Startup += (_, _) => _ = Task.Run(() => RunCommandsAsync(lifetime)));
        }
        finally
        {
            if (WorkbenchApp.Instance is { } app)
                Task.Run(app.StopMcpAsync).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }
    }

    private static async Task RunCommandsAsync(IClassicDesktopStyleApplicationLifetime lifetime)
    {
        try
        {
            while (string.Equals(await Console.In.ReadLineAsync().ConfigureAwait(false), "focus", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                await Dispatcher.UIThread.InvokeAsync<Task>(() =>
                    WorkbenchRemoteControl.ClickAsync(lifetime.MainWindow!, "workbench.view.focus.toolbar"))

            }
        }

        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine(ex);
        }
        finally
        {
            await Dispatcher.UIThread.InvokeAsync(() => lifetime.MainWindow?.Close()).GetTask().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.RemoteControl.Server;
using Avalonia.RemoteControl.Server.Rendering;
using Avalonia.RemoteControl.Server.Threading;
using Avalonia.VisualTree;
using Dock.Model.Core;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using RetroIde.Testing;
using RetroIde.Workbench;

namespace RetroIde.NativeTests;

internal static class RemoteControlDockingTests
{
    /// <summary>TEST-RETRO-001#verify-ac-behavior-desktop-1; TEST-RETRO-007#ac-test-system-wait-cursor</summary>
    public static async Task RunAsync(CancellationTokenSource finished)
    {
        try
        {
            using var session = new WorkbenchSession(Guid.NewGuid());
            var window = new WorkbenchWindow(session);
            window.Show();
            try
            {
                await WorkbenchRemoteControl.ClickAsync(window, "workbench.view.focus.toolbar").ConfigureAwait(true);
                var pending = session.View.FocusCommand.ExecutionTask
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The RemoteControl toolbar action did not start the registered command.");
                await pending.ConfigureAwait(true);
                if (!session.Layout.IsFocused("registers") || session.View.WorkbenchRevision != 1)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("The RemoteControl toolbar action did not focus Registers once.");

                await VerifyWaitLifecycleAsync(session, window).ConfigureAwait(true);
                var tool = session.Layout.Tool("registers");
                var owner = (IDock)tool.Owner!;
                var anchor = session.Layout.Tool("call-stack");
                session.Layout.Factory.FloatDockable(tool);
                var floating = session.Layout.Root.Windows?.SingleOrDefault()?.Host as Window
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Registers did not open a native floating host.");
                var primaryHandle = window.TryGetPlatformHandle()
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The workbench has no platform window handle.");
                var floatingHandle = floating.TryGetPlatformHandle()
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The floating Registers tool has no platform window handle.");
                if (floatingHandle.Handle == primaryHandle.Handle)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Registers did not receive a distinct platform window.");

                await VerifyWaitLifecycleAsync(session, floating).ConfigureAwait(true);
                session.Layout.Factory.MoveDockable((IDock)tool.Owner!, owner, tool, anchor);
                if (!ReferenceEquals(owner, tool.Owner) || !ReferenceEquals(session.Layout.Root, session.Layout.Factory.FindRoot(tool)))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Registers did not redock to its original group.");

                Console.WriteLine($"RemoteControl focused Registers once and verified a native Dock float and redock. Main: {primaryHandle.HandleDescriptor}; float: {floatingHandle.HandleDescriptor}. No desktop input was used.");
            }
            finally { window.Close(); }
        }
        finally { finished.Cancel(); }
    }

    private static async Task VerifyWaitLifecycleAsync(WorkbenchSession session, Window window)
    {
        var tool = session.Layout.Tool("registers");
        using var layoutTimeout = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(6));
        Border? overlay;
        do
        {
            window.UpdateLayout();
            overlay = window.GetVisualDescendants().OfType<Border>()
                .SingleOrDefault(border => string.Equals(border.Name, "InteractionSurface", StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
                    ReferenceEquals(border.DataContext, tool) && border.GetVisualParent() is Grid { IsEffectivelyVisible: true });
            if (overlay is null)
                await Task.Delay(30, layoutTimeout.Token).ConfigureAwait(true);
        } while (overlay is null);

        var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var background = session.Interaction.RunAsync(null, _ => release.Task);
        Task? blocked = null;
        try
        {
            if (overlay.IsVisible || overlay.Cursor is not null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Background work displayed a Wait cursor in Registers.");

            blocked = session.Interaction.RunAsync("registers", _ => release.Task);
            VerifyBlocked(overlay);
            var frames = new AvaloniaRenderTargetFrameProvider(
                Options.Create(new AvaloniaRemoteControlOptions { AllowRemoteFrames = true }),
                new AvaloniaUiThreadRemoteControlDispatcher());
            using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            var frame = await frames.CaptureFrameAsync(window, 1, timeout.Token).ConfigureAwait(true);
            if (frame is not { PixelWidth: > 0, PixelHeight: > 0, Png.Length: > 0 } || blocked.IsCompleted)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The remote workbench did not render a frame during a pending block.");

            await CheckCancelledBlockAsync(session).ConfigureAwait(true);
            VerifyBlocked(overlay);
            await CheckFailedBlockAsync(session).ConfigureAwait(true);
            VerifyBlocked(overlay);
        }
        finally
        {
            release.TrySetResult();
            await background.ConfigureAwait(true);
            if (blocked is not null)
                await blocked.ConfigureAwait(true);
        }

        if (overlay.IsVisible || overlay.Cursor is not null || session.Interaction.IsBlocked("registers"))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Registers did not restore its unblocked cursor and input state.");

        Console.WriteLine($"RemoteControl rendered {window.TryGetPlatformHandle()?.HandleDescriptor} during a block and verified Wait scope across overlapping success, cancellation, and failure.");
    }

    private static void VerifyBlocked(Border overlay)
    {
        if (!overlay.IsVisible || !string.Equals(overlay.Cursor?.ToString(), "Wait", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Registers did not expose its platform Wait cursor.");
    }

    private static async Task CheckCancelledBlockAsync(WorkbenchSession session)
    {
        using var cancel = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var operation = session.Interaction.RunAsync("registers", token => Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, token), cancel.Token);
        await cancel.CancelAsync().ConfigureAwait(true);
        try { await operation.ConfigureAwait(true); }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancel.IsCancellationRequested) { return; }
        throw new InvalidOperationException("The overlapping Registers block did not cancel.");
    }

    private static async Task CheckFailedBlockAsync(WorkbenchSession session)
    {
        var expected = new InvalidOperationException("Fixture failure");
        try
        {
            await session.Interaction.RunAsync("registers", _ => Task.FromException(expected)).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }
        catch (InvalidOperationException actual) when (ReferenceEquals(actual, expected)) { return; }
        throw new InvalidOperationException("The overlapping Registers block did not propagate failure.");
    }
}

using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using RetroIde.Application;

namespace RetroIde.UnitTests;

/// <summary>Checks the published workbench context and typed feature inventory.</summary>
public sealed class ViewModelContextContractTests
{
    /// <summary>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-viewmodel-context</summary>
    [Fact]
    public void Public_schema_and_snapshot_share_an_exact_allowlist()
    {
        var contract = new ViewContextContract(typeof(WorkbenchViewModel));
        var view = new WorkbenchViewModel(Guid.NewGuid());
        var schema = contract.Schema;
        var snapshot = contract.Capture(view);
        string[] expected = ["activeToolId", "viewKey", "workbenchRevision", "workspaceId"];

        Assert.Equal(expected, Fields(schema.GetProperty("properties")));
        Assert.Equal(expected, Fields(snapshot));
        Assert.False(schema.GetProperty("additionalProperties").GetBoolean());
        Assert.Equal(view.ViewKey, snapshot.GetProperty("viewKey").GetGuid());
        Assert.Equal(view.WorkspaceId, snapshot.GetProperty("workspaceId").GetGuid());
        Assert.Equal(0, snapshot.GetProperty("workbenchRevision").GetInt64());
        var properties = schema.GetProperty("properties");
        Assert.Equal(0, properties.GetProperty("workbenchRevision").GetProperty("minimum").GetInt32());
        Assert.Equal(Guid.Empty, properties.GetProperty("viewKey").GetProperty("not").GetProperty("const").GetGuid());
        Assert.Equal(Guid.Empty, properties.GetProperty("workspaceId").GetProperty("not").GetProperty("const").GetGuid());

        var submitted = JsonNode.Parse(snapshot.GetRawText())!.AsObject();
        submitted["workbenchRevision"] = -1;
        Assert.False(contract.TryRead(JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(submitted), out var negative));
        Assert.Null(negative);
        submitted["workbenchRevision"] = 0;
        submitted["viewKey"] = Guid.Empty;
        Assert.False(contract.TryRead(JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(submitted), out var empty));
        Assert.Null(empty);
        Assert.False(contract.TryRead(JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { view.ViewKey, command = "hidden" }, WireJson.Options), out _));
    }

    /// <summary>TEST-RETRO-015#ac-test-mcp-inventory</summary>
    [Fact]
    public void Every_feature_has_a_unique_tool_and_context_contract()
    {
        var contract = new ViewContextContract(typeof(WorkbenchViewModel));
        var registry = new FeatureRegistry(contract);
        Assert.Equal(["workbench_focus_tool", "workbench_get_context"], registry.Features.Select(x => x.ToolName).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal), StringComparer.Ordinal);
        Assert.Equal(registry.Features.Count, registry.Features.Select(x => x.Id).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count());
        var focus = registry.Describe(registry.FocusTool);
        var read = registry.Describe(registry.GetContext);
        Assert.Equal(contract.Schema.GetRawText(), focus.InputSchema.GetProperty("properties").GetProperty("context").GetRawText());
        Assert.Equal(contract.Schema.GetRawText(), read.OutputSchema.GetProperty("properties").GetProperty("context").GetRawText());
    }

    private static string[] Fields(JsonElement element) => element.EnumerateObject().Select(x => x.Name).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
}
